cron-fail-closed.ref: Follow-up to #3141 (Codex findings, 2026-10-18), server/cron/jobs/missedCallRecovery.ts. Who gets a callback row now comes from sms.ts loadSuppressionIndex: a number in `phones` (any STOP source, customers.smsOptOut, consent-ledger revoke, or a spoken voice opt-out) gets no text and no row; `carrierBlocked` and not in `phones` is the one SMS-only scope and gets a row instead of a text; an unreadable index (ok: false, or the loader throwing) writes no rows, and so does a stale one (ok: true, stale: true after a failed refresh, sms.ts:186-188; Codex P1 on #3143, red first 1 failed / 25 passed, arm (a'''') live and shadow). The test file's ../sms mock is partial via importOriginal (only loadSuppressionIndex overridden); an in-file canary asserting carrierBlockedPhones, sendSms and markPhoneFullyOptedOut stay real was red on the old full factory ('No carrierBlockedPhones export is defined on the ../sms mock'), and missedCallRecovery + staleCallbackEscalation + every server/sms*.test.ts + __tests__/smsCarrierBlock.test.ts, shuffled, gave 35 files, 633 passed at seed 29 and at seed 7. The shadow pool drops held claims before the RUN_CAP slice. recoveryCallbackRowId is written after the insert; a recoveryCallbackAt stamp over 60 min old with no row id is reclaimed by a CAS pinned on the old stamp and the row id being NULL; a fresh stamp or a recorded row id is a duplicate. A caller with no usable number (normalizePhone null) is never claimed and takes no cap slot. All warn lines log describeDbError, never the driver message. The callback helper still never throws, and the job's outer catch still rethrows a failed run. Arms in server/__tests__/missedCallRecovery.test.ts: (a) carrier-blocked live -> one row + rowId write; (a') opt-out -> no row in live and shadow; (a'') index STOP and voice-only -> no row, open -> row; (a''') unreadable index -> no rows; (f) 15 of 20 already held -> rows for the other 5; (g) stale stamp without row id reclaimed on the old stamp, fresh and completed stamps untouched; (h) 'anonymous' and '1234' never claimed, 15 rows for the rest; (e) a DrizzleQueryError whose params hold a fake 10-digit number: logged payload has the call id and ER_LOCK_WAIT_TIMEOUT but not the number, the release failure is logged too, the text lane still runs. Red first on the pre-fix code (f38f69bd5^): 9 failed / 16 passed. Mutants M1 held rows kept in the pool, M2 index phones ignored, M3 err.message logged, M4 reclaim not pinned on the old stamp, M4b row id ignored, M5 no usable-phone filter -> 6 / 6 killed. Re-run for THIS diff: missedCallRecovery + staleCallbackEscalation + cronNoSwallowedFailure + cronRethrow2026 + cron-rethrow + cronInventoryParity + opportunityMissedCallClosure, shuffled seed 29 -> 7 files, 90 passed; tsc --noEmit exit 0.
